responsibility: This file implements RTL-side support routines for preserving user-visible variable values and locations in debug information as optimization rewrites or kills registers. It rewrites auto-increment expressions into side-effect-free forms for DEBUG_INSNs, propagates substitutions into debug statements, manages debug temporaries and global/local tables for dead registers still referenced by debug uses, and emits replacement debug binds when values would otherwise be lost. It is a backend debug-info preservation utility used by passes such as shrink-wrapping and variable tracking, distinct from the main global var-tracking analysis pass.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/valtrack.h, which declares the dead-debug tracking data structures and APIs, this .cc file implements the RTL debug-value preservation algorithms, such as rewriting auto-increment forms for DEBUG_INSNs, propagating substitutions, and inserting debug temporaries and replacement binds.
